items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Also in Texas I had a chance to meet Don Albert

ctx.x: MR. PILLARS: Hershel Evans. Hershel Evans, a very fine person a very fine tenor player. Hershel was born in Temple, Texas, and we discussed music and -- and the big bands and what-not. Later on Hershel left Texas and joined the Count Basie band, and made the original record the Count made of "One O'Clock Jump."

Also in Texas I had a chance to meet Don Albert, Don Albert was a bandleader there that's quite popular. With the Spanish people there. My brother, Charles Pillars, pined this particular band a year or two later. More about that later, too.
